additional_info.body:
Dear Szymon,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002136
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
yTPBGK
Problem Description
: Router Login Failed
Troubleshooting
: On site intervention
For future reference, your ticket number is
0383078
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We have rebooted the charger, but issue has not been resolved, we will need on site intervention with one spare router and LAN cable. Also make sure you have working companion tool on your laptop to configure router if required.
This issue is related to communication between PLC and router 2. First, we have to check the connection between XF2 and XF4 and power on XF4, if all are ok then we need to replace router.
Let me know when you can plan for site intervention and if you need support on this.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar

additional_info.subject: RE: 0383078 - ID0383078-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R6 170002136] Router Login Failed CRM:00658000765
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
Greetings of the day
We replaced LAN cable as well as router 2 on this charger.
Once we replaced the router, we can still see this charger is failsafe mode.
We reset both the routers through "firstboot" command and now the charger is live and working.
Since your issue has been resolved, we will be proceeding with closing the service ticket# 0383078.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by sending a new email to
emobility_support.si@siemens.com
.
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Saurav Kumar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
